# hexcore_sizes (Data Source)

Read the HexCore sizes catalog. Results are ordered by slug, then ID where available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hexcore_sizes" "available" {}

output "sizes" {
  value = data.hexcore_sizes.available.sizes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sizes` (Attributes List) Catalog entries in stable order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `hour_price` (String) Hourly price as decimal text in rubles.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `month_price` (String) Monthly price as decimal text in rubles.
- `slug` (String) Catalog slug.
- `vcpu` (Number) Virtual CPU count.
